name: _nav.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  star-field/_nav.scss — the left-side body navigator drawer: toggle button,
//  slide-in panel, grouped searchable body list, item meta, and the
//  "show more" pagination button. Chrome follows the --sf-* theme vars on
//  :host (light glass ⇄ dark glass); the toggle carries the project's
//  corner-bracket button signature.
//  Imported by star-field.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// Navigator toggle — corner-bracket chrome matching .sf-btn.
.#{$_B_SF}-nav-toggle {
  @extend %RESETBTN;
  @extend %TTL_XS;

  position: absolute;
  // Inside the framed viewport — one pad up from the canvas bottom edge.
  bottom: calc(#{to-rem($space-xl)} + #{to-rem($space-md)});
  left: calc(#{to-rem($gap-272)} + #{to-rem($space-md)});
  z-index: 30;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-lg);
  color: var(--sf-ink);
  background: var(--sf-chrome-2);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
  backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-xs));
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
  cursor: pointer;

  // Track the site's content gutter at every grid step — mirrors %MAXAREA,
  // plus the inner pad that clears the viewport frame.
  @include grid-steps() using ($step, $gap, $cols) {
    left: calc(#{to-rem($gap)} + #{to-rem($space-md)});
  }

  &::before,
  &::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: to-rem($space-sm);
    height: to-rem($space-sm);
    transition:
      width 0.25s ease,
      height 0.25s ease;
  }

  &::before {
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    border-top: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-ink-2);
    border-left: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-ink-2);
  }

  &::after {
    bottom: 0;
    right: 0;
    border-bottom: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-ink-2);
    border-right: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-ink-2);
  }

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    opacity: 0.75;

    &::before,
    &::after {
      width: calc(100% - to-rem($space-2xs));
      height: calc(100% - to-rem($space-2xs));
    }
  }
}

// Floating catalog card — clears the fixed logo/nav chrome and tracks the
// site gutter like the dossier panel, so the logo never sits on chrome
// and the drawer respects the content column.
.#{$_B_SF}-nav {
  position: absolute;
  top: $_NAV_INSET;
  left: to-rem($gap-272);
  // Bottom inset matches the nav-toggle/action buttons' own offset so
  // the drawer's lower edge lands on the same line as the bottom chrome.
  bottom: calc(#{to-rem($space-xl)} + #{to-rem($space-md)});
  z-index: 40;
  width: min(#{to-rem($space-7xl)}, 84vw);
  translate: calc(-100% - #{to-rem($space-4xl)}) 0;
  // Fully unpaintable while closed — a slide-only hide can leave the card's
  // border as a sliver at the screen edge on narrow/short viewports.
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition:
    translate 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
    opacity 0.3s ease,
    visibility 0s linear 0.45s;
  pointer-events: none;

  @include grid-steps() using ($step, $gap, $cols) {
    left: to-rem($gap);
  }

  &--open {
    translate: 0 0;
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transition:
      translate 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      opacity 0.3s ease;
    pointer-events: auto;
  }

  &-panel {
    height: 100%;
    // Content-box sizing would add the padding on top of the 100%
    // track — the card then overflows its container and drops below
    // the viewport edge (bigger than the dossier panel, no bottom
    // margin). Border-box keeps the padding inside the track.
    box-sizing: border-box;
    overflow-y: auto;
    // Contain touch scrolls inside the sheet — without this the gesture
    // chains to the page scroller and the list feels unscrollable.
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    padding: to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-xl);
    background: var(--sf-chrome);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-md));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-md));
    border: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-hover);
  }

  // Pinned strip — sticky header + search inside the scrolling panel.
  // The sticky inset applies to the element's MARGIN edge: with the
  // -3xl top margin that reaches the card edge, `top: 0` would clamp
  // the margin box flush and leave the border box 3xl below — a bare
  // band where scrolled items show through. `top: -3xl` cancels the
  // margin so the border box itself docks at the scrollport top while
  // the group list scrolls beneath; the negative side margins still
  // span the strip across the panel's padding gutters so scrolled
  // items never peek past its edge, and the opaque chrome (bg + blur)
  // hides them. Rounded top corners mirror the card's --radius-md.
  &-pin {
    position: sticky;
    top: calc(-1 * #{to-rem($space-3xl)});
    z-index: 2;
    margin: calc(-1 * to-rem($space-3xl)) calc(-1 * to-rem($space-xl)) 0;
    padding: to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-xs);
    background: var(--sf-chrome);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-md));
    backdrop-filter: blur(to-rem($space-md));
    border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0;
    border-bottom: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line);
  }

  &-head {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-md);
    margin: 0 0 to-rem($space-xl);
  }

  &-heading {
    @extend .ttl-xs;

    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--sf-ink-strong);
    margin: 0;
    flex: 1;
  }

  // In-drawer dismiss — the dossier panel's close, ported to the nav card
  // so pointer users never hunt for the toggle (Escape still works).
  &-close {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
    color: var(--sf-ink);
    padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);
    cursor: pointer;

    &:hover,
    &:focus-visible {
      color: var(--sf-ink-strong);
    }
  }

  &-group {
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
  }

  &-group-title {
    @extend .txt-xs;

    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--sf-ink-2);
    margin: 0 0 to-rem($space-sm);
  }

  &-list {
    @include reset-list;
  }

  &-item {
    @extend %RESETBTN;

    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: left;
    font-family: var(--font-mono);
    font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
    color: var(--sf-ink);
    padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-xs);
    cursor: pointer;

    &:hover,
    &:focus-visible {
      color: var(--sf-ink-strong);
    }

    &--active {
      color: var(--sf-ink-strong);
    }
  }
}

.#{$_B_SF}-nav-search {
  width: 100%;
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
  color: var(--sf-ink-strong);
  background: var(--sf-field);
  border: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-md);
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
  outline: none;

  &::placeholder {
    color: var(--sf-ink-3);
  }

  &:focus-visible {
    border-color: var(--sf-ink-2);
  }
}

.#{$_B_SF}-nav-item-meta {
  @extend .txt-xs;

  font-weight: 400;
  display: block;
  color: var(--sf-ink-3);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  margin-top: to-rem($space-2xs);
}

// In-drawer scale disclaimer — hidden on desktop where the pinned strip
// carries it; _mobile.scss flips it on so the text lives in the sheet
// instead of cluttering the bottom chrome.
.#{$_B_SF}-nav-disclaimer {
  @extend .txt-xs;

  display: none;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--sf-ink-3);
  line-height: 1.75;
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  margin: to-rem($space-xl) 0 0;
  padding-top: to-rem($space-lg);
  border-top: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line-2);
}

.#{$_B_SF}-nav-more {
  @extend .txt-xs;

  font-weight: 500;
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-sm);
  margin-top: to-rem($space-2xs);
  color: var(--sf-ink-strong);
  text-align: center;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: var(--sf-field);
  border: var(--space-hairline) solid var(--sf-line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);

  &:hover,
  &:focus-visible {
    background: var(--sf-field-hover);
  }
}
